title: 걷기 · 조깅
intro: '걷기·조깅'은 조깅 장소 묘사 → 조깅 루틴 → 처음 시작한 계기나 기억에 남는 경험 → 예전과 지금의 변화 비교 순서로 출제됩니다. 페르소나는 수업이 많아 바쁜 경영학과 대학생으로, 일주일에 세 번 저녁에 한강에서 30분씩 뛰며 스트레스를 풉니다. 한강 코스 하나와 '바쁜 하루 끝에 머리를 식힌다'는 이유 하나만 정해 두면 네 문제 모두 같은 이야기로 연결됩니다.
strategy: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장(Oh, jogging? Sure, I'd love to talk about it.) → 기본 정보(어디서·얼마나 자주) → 세부(코스·준비물·뛴 후) → 느낌·이유(스트레스 해소) → 마무리 문장(So yeah, that's my jogging routine.)
장소는 항상 '집에서 자전거로 10분 거리의 한강 산책로' 하나로 고정하세요. 평평한 길, 강 경치, 저녁 불빛 같은 쉬운 묘사 3개면 충분합니다.
루틴은 빈도(three times a week) → 시간대(in the evening) → 준비(stretch, earphones) → 30분 뛰기 → 집에 와서 샤워 순서로 시간 흐름을 따라가면 막히지 않습니다.
경험·비교 질문은 '대학교 1학년 때 시험 스트레스로 시작 → 처음엔 10분도 힘들었음 → 지금은 30분 거뜬' 이야기 하나로 둘 다 답할 수 있습니다.

expressions.en: Oh, jogging? Sure, I'd love to talk about it.
expressions.note: 주제 시작 문장: 질문 키워드를 한 번 되묻고 시작

expressions.en: I go jogging three times a week, usually in the evening.
expressions.ko: 저는 일주일에 세 번, 보통 저녁에 조깅해요.

expressions.en: I usually jog along the Han River.
It takes about ten minutes by bike from my apartment.
Before I run, I always stretch a little.
expressions.ko: 뛰기 전에 항상 스트레칭을 조금 해요.

expressions.en: I listen to K-pop with my earphones while I run.
I feel so refreshed after a run.
My weekdays are pretty busy because I have a lot of classes.
Jogging is how I get rid of stress.
At first, I could barely run for ten minutes.
I've been jogging for about two years now.
I used to run only on weekends, but now I go on weekdays too.
expressions.ko: 예전엔 주말에만 뛰었는데 지금은 평일에도 가요.

expressions.en: Once I get into a rhythm, the time just flies by.
expressions.ko: 리듬을 타기 시작하면 시간이 정말 금방 가요.

expressions.en: So yeah, that's pretty much why I love jogging.
expressions.ko: 그러니까 네, 그게 제가 조깅을 좋아하는 이유예요.
expressions.note: 마무리 문장: So yeah, that's pretty much ~

questions.en: You indicated in the survey that you go walking or jogging. Where do you usually go? Describe the place for me in as much detail as possible.
questions.ko: 설문에서 걷기나 조깅을 한다고 하셨네요. 보통 어디로 가나요? 그 장소를 최대한 자세히 묘사해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 장소(한강, 자전거 10분) → 길과 풍경 묘사 → 왜 좋은지 → 'Yeah, that's ~' 마무리
flat, wide, quiet, pretty 같은 쉬운 형용사 3~4개면 충분해요
저녁 풍경(sunset, city lights)을 한 문장 넣으면 장면이 생생해져요

answers.IM3: Oh, jogging? Sure, let me tell you about my favorite place. I usually jog along the Han River. It takes about ten minutes by bike from my apartment. There is a long path next to the river. The path is flat and wide, so it's easy to run. There are trees and benches along the way. In the evening, I can see the city lights on the water. It's really pretty. Yeah, that's my favorite place to jog.
answers.IH: Oh, jogging? Sure, I'd love to talk about it. I usually jog along the Han River near my place. I live in a quiet neighborhood in Seoul, and the river is only about ten minutes away by bike. So I ride my bike there and start running. The path is flat and wide, and it goes along the river for a long way. There are trees, benches, and a few convenience stores, so I can grab some water if I need it. I usually go in the evening, so I can see the sunset and the city lights on the water. It's really beautiful. There are a lot of other runners and cyclists, but it never feels too crowded. After a busy day of classes, this place helps me relax. So yeah, that's pretty much my favorite jogging spot.
answers.AL: Oh, jogging? Sure, I'd love to talk about it, because it's honestly one of my favorite parts of the week. I usually jog along the Han River. I live with my family in a quiet neighborhood in Seoul, and the river is only about ten minutes from my apartment by bike. So I just hop on my bike, ride down there, and start running. The path is flat and really wide, and it goes on for kilometers, so I never get bored. There are trees and benches on one side and the river on the other. There are also a few convenience stores along the way, which is great when I need a cold drink. I usually go in the evening, right around sunset. The sky turns orange and pink, and then the city lights start to come on and reflect on the water. It's so pretty that I sometimes stop just to take a picture. There are lots of other runners, people walking their dogs, and couples sitting by the river. It feels lively, but somehow peaceful at the same time. After a long day of classes, it's exactly what I need. So yeah, that's pretty much why the Han River is my favorite place to jog.

questions.en: Tell me about your typical walking or jogging routine. How often do you go, what do you do before and after, and what do you bring with you?
questions.ko: 평소 걷기나 조깅 루틴을 말해 주세요. 얼마나 자주 가는지, 전후에 무엇을 하는지, 무엇을 챙겨 가는지요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 빈도·시간대 → 준비(옷·스트레칭·이어폰) → 30분 뛰기 → 집에 와서 샤워 → 마무리
First / Then / After that / When I get home 으로 순서를 잡으세요
'수업이 많아 바빠서 저녁에 뛴다'는 이유를 넣으면 페르소나와 자연스럽게 연결돼요

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you about my jogging routine. I jog three times a week, usually on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. I go in the evening after my classes. First, I change into comfortable clothes and running shoes. Then I ride my bike to the Han River. I stretch a little and run for about 30 minutes. I always bring my phone and earphones. When I get home, I take a shower. Yeah, that's my jogging routine.
answers.IH: Okay, let me tell you about my jogging routine. I go jogging about three times a week, usually on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. My weekdays are pretty busy because I have a lot of classes, so I usually go in the evening, around eight. When I get home from school, I change into comfortable clothes and my running shoes. Then I ride my bike to the Han River, which takes about ten minutes. Before I start, I always stretch for a few minutes, because I don't want to get hurt. I bring my phone, my earphones, and a small bottle of water. I listen to K-pop while I run, and I run for about 30 minutes. After that, I walk slowly for a bit to cool down. When I get home, I take a shower and have a light snack. So yeah, that's pretty much my routine.
answers.AL: Okay, let me walk you through my jogging routine. I try to go three times a week, usually on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. My weekdays are pretty packed because I have a lot of classes, so evenings are really the only time I can go. I usually get home from school around six, have a quick dinner with my family, and then rest for a bit. Around eight, I change into comfortable clothes and my running shoes, and I ride my bike down to the Han River. It only takes about ten minutes. Before I start, I always stretch for five minutes or so. I learned that the hard way, because I hurt my ankle once when I skipped it. I keep my gear pretty simple, just my phone, my earphones, and a small bottle of water. I put on my K-pop playlist, usually some IU songs, and I run for about 30 minutes. Once I get into a rhythm, the time just flies by. After that, I walk slowly for a few minutes to cool down and enjoy the view. When I get home, I take a nice hot shower, and I always sleep really well on those nights. So yeah, that's pretty much what my jogging routine looks like.

questions.en: When did you first start walking or jogging? What made you start, and what was it like at the beginning? Tell me the story from start to finish.
questions.ko: 처음 걷기나 조깅을 시작한 건 언제인가요? 왜 시작했고, 처음엔 어땠나요? 처음부터 끝까지 이야기해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 언제(대학교 1학년) → 계기(시험 스트레스·운동 부족) → 처음의 어려움 → 지금의 변화 → 마무리
과거시제를 유지하세요: started, was, felt, could barely, went
'That's how I got into jogging.' 같은 마무리 문장으로 이야기를 깔끔하게 닫으세요

answers.IM3: Oh, let me think. I started jogging about two years ago. I was a freshman in college then. I had a lot of exams, and I was really stressed. I also didn't exercise at all. So one evening, I went to the Han River and tried to run. I could only run for ten minutes. I was so tired! But I kept going every week. Now I can run for 30 minutes easily. Yeah, that's how I started jogging.
answers.IH: Oh, let me think. I started jogging about two years ago, when I was a freshman in college. Back then, I had a lot of exams and assignments, and I was really stressed out. I was sitting at my desk all day, and I didn't exercise at all. One day, my friend Minji told me that jogging helped her a lot. So that evening, I rode my bike to the Han River and tried to run. Honestly, I could barely run for ten minutes. I was out of breath, and my legs hurt for two days. But I felt really refreshed, so I went again a few days later. After about a month, I could run for 30 minutes without stopping. I also noticed that I was sleeping better and feeling less stressed. So yeah, that's how I got into jogging.
answers.AL: Oh, that's a good question. Let me think. I started jogging about two years ago, back when I was a freshman in college. That first semester was a lot harder than I expected. I had tons of exams and group assignments, and I was stressed out pretty much all the time. I was sitting at my desk all day, eating snacks late at night, and I wasn't exercising at all. Then one day, my friend Minji told me she'd started running and that it really cleared her head. I thought, why not? So that evening, I put on my old sneakers, rode my bike to the Han River, and tried to run. It was a disaster. I could barely run for ten minutes before I had to stop and catch my breath, and my legs were sore for two days straight. But the funny thing is, I felt amazing afterward, like all my stress was gone. So I went back a few days later, and then again. After about a month, I could run for 30 minutes without stopping, and I was sleeping way better too. I never expected something so simple to change my daily life that much. So yeah, that's pretty much how I got into jogging.

questions.en: How has your walking or jogging changed since you first started? Compare what it was like back then with what it is like now.
questions.ko: 처음 시작했을 때와 비교해 걷기나 조깅이 어떻게 달라졌나요? 그때와 지금을 비교해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 처음(When I first started) → 지금(Now) → 가장 큰 변화와 이유 → 마무리
used to + 동사원형으로 예전 습관을 말하면 비교가 또렷해져요

answers.IM3: Sure, I'd love to talk about it. My jogging has changed a lot. When I first started, I ran only on weekends. I could only run for ten minutes. I wore my old sneakers, and I didn't stretch. Now I jog three times a week in the evening. I can run for 30 minutes, and I have good running shoes. Before, jogging was hard. Now it's fun and relaxing. Yeah, that's how my jogging has changed.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about it. My jogging habits have changed quite a lot. When I first started two years ago, I used to run only on weekends. I could barely run for ten minutes, and I didn't know anything about stretching. I just wore my old sneakers and an old T-shirt. Now I jog three times a week, on weekday evenings after my classes. I can easily run for 30 minutes, and I bought a good pair of running shoes. I also always stretch before I run. But the biggest change is my reason for jogging. At first, I ran because I felt like I had to exercise. Now I run because I really enjoy it. It's how I get rid of stress from my busy school life. So yeah, jogging went from something hard to something I actually look forward to.
answers.AL: Sure, I'd love to talk about it, because it's changed a lot more than I expected. When I first started two years ago, I used to run only on Saturday mornings, and even that felt like a lot. I could barely run for ten minutes without stopping. I didn't have any real gear, just my old sneakers and a baggy T-shirt, and I never stretched, which is probably why I was always sore. These days, it's a totally different story. I jog three times a week, on weekday evenings after my classes, and 30 minutes feels pretty comfortable now. I finally bought a good pair of running shoes, and I never skip my stretching. I even have a special playlist just for running. But honestly, the biggest change is in my mind, not my legs. In the beginning, jogging felt like homework, something I had to do to be healthy. Now it's the part of my day that I look forward to the most. My weekdays are really busy, so those 30 minutes by the river are like my own little break from everything. It's not about speed for me anymore. It's about clearing my head. So yeah, that's pretty much how my jogging has changed.

pronunciation.tip: 첫 음절 '좌'에 강세. '조깅'처럼 '오'로 발음하지 말고 입을 크게 벌려 '아'에 가깝게
한 음절. '스트레치'처럼 4음절로 늘리지 말고 str을 한 번에 붙여서
r은 혀를 입천장에 닿지 않게 말고, v는 윗니로 아랫입술을 살짝 물어서
명사 breath는 짧은 '에'와 무성 th. 동사 breathe /briːð/와 구분 (out of breath)
